background.title: Russo-Ukrainian war
background.extract: The Russo-Ukrainian war began in February 2014 and is ongoing. Following Ukraine's Revolution of Dignity, Russia occupied Crimea and annexed it from Ukraine. It then supported Russian separatist armed groups who started a war in the eastern Donbas region against Ukraine's military. In 2018, Ukraine declared the region to be occupied by Russia. The first eight years of conflict also involved naval incidents and cyberwarfare. In February 2022, Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine and began occupying more of the country, starting the current phase of the war, the largest conflict in Europe since World War II. The war has resulted in a refugee crisis and hundreds of thousands of deaths.

headlines.title: Ukrainian Film Festival kicks off in Poland on Nov 2, with 50 films to be screened in 12 cities

headlines.title: Ukrainian forces evacuate civilians around Kherson Oblast during Oleshky ceasefire

headlines.title: Ukrainian judoka Savytskyi wins bronze at Grand Slam in UAE
headlines.excerpt: The latest 2026 Grand Slam tournament was held in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, with 11 Ukrainian judokas competing.

headlines.excerpt: The Zaporizhzhia region provided the Ukrainian Defense Forces with military equipment worth more than UAH 105 million in October, with 45 units receiving assistance.

headlines.title: Kherson braces for return of war as localised Russia-Ukraine truce ends
headlines.excerpt: Moscow and Kyiv continue strikes elsewhere, but no reported violations in Kherson region during the six-day ceasefire.

headlines.title: Ukraine, Türkiye considering cooperation on satellite technologies – Zelensky
headlines.excerpt: Ukraine and Türkiye have discussed opportunities for cooperation in satellite technologies, the development of which is important for the security of both countries.

headlines.title: Russian drones attack settlement in Kharkiv region, five people injured
headlines.excerpt: Russian forces carried out drone strikes on the settlement of Vasyshcheve in the Kharkiv region, injuring five people.

headlines.title: Zelensky announces visit by Turkish energy companies to Ukraine
headlines.excerpt: Representatives of Turkish energy companies will visit Ukraine next week to develop joint projects.

headlines.title: Zelenskyy comments on possibility of meeting Putin in Turkiye
headlines.excerpt: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is ready to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin in Turkiye if Ankara can organize such a meeting, the Ukrainian leader said in an interview with CNN Turk on Nov. 1.

headlines.title: Two people injured in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia
headlines.excerpt: Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia with an FPV drone in the evening, injuring two people.

headlines.title: Ukraine has not yet received official invitation to G20 summit – Zelensky
headlines.excerpt: Ukraine has not yet received an official invitation to the G20 summit, although relevant signals have been received from negotiators.

headlines.title: Zelensky says he is ready to meet Putin in Türkiye
headlines.excerpt: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said he was ready to meet Vladimir Putin in Türkiye and stressed the need for talks at the leaders’ level to end the war.

headlines.title: Ukraine’s air defenses down 274 Russian drones, six Banderols on Sunday
headlines.excerpt: Ukraine’s air defenses neutralized 274 drones and six S8000 Banderol/Dan-T jet-powered loitering munitions used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine during the day on November 1.

headlines.title: Nearly 50 Ukrainian drones taken down over Russian regions during day
headlines.excerpt: Russian air defense systems intercepted and destroyed 47 Ukrainian fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles ver the Belgorod, Nizhny Novgorod, Kursk, Kaluga, Tula, Voronezh, Smolensk, Rostov, and Moscow Regions

headlines.title: Putin could answer Zelenskyy's call, Kremlin says
headlines.excerpt: Vladimir Putin could answer a call from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, Yuri Ushakov, an aide to Russian President Vladimir Putin, said in a comment to Vesti on Nov. 1.

headlines.title: Ukraine's air defence downed 274 attack drones and all six Bandеrol cruise missiles on Sunday, Air Force says
headlines.excerpt: Ukraine's Air Force says air defence shot down or jammed 274 out of 326 Russian drones and all six S8000 Banderol missiles on 1 November.

headlines.title: Ukrainian foreign minister says Russia's return to ice hockey will stain ice with Ukrainian blood
headlines.excerpt: Andrii Sybiha has condemned the decision to allow Russia to return to international ice hockey as unacceptable and urged governments to deny entry to Russian teams.

headlines.title: Rubio doubts Ukraine peace deal can be reached any time soon – Radio Liberty
headlines.excerpt: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has reportedly told his Western counterparts that short-term NATO membership for Kyiv is unrealistic.

headlines.title: Foreign Minister Sybiha calls for Russian athlete travel ban as Moscow's ice hockey return risks forcing Ukraine out
headlines.excerpt: "I call on governments that have not lost their moral compass to deny Russian players entry to their territory," said Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha.

headlines.title: ‘I’ve Developed Thirst for Life’ – Wounded Ukrainian Veteran
headlines.excerpt: Ukrainian veteran Serhiy Hrachov, who was wounded several times, once feared becoming a burden to his family, now speaks enthusiastically about their future.

headlines.title: Russian forces hit vessel with cargoes for Ukrainian army near Odessa — defense ministry
headlines.excerpt: According to the ministry, during the day, Russian forces continued drone attacks on sea vessels that are used to transport military cargoes

headlines.title: Russia set a record for losses in October, and Ukraine took back more land than it lost
headlines.excerpt: Ukraine’s president tied the two counts together and said Russia could stop the bleeding by choosing a ceasefire and diplomacy.

headlines.title: Ukraine, Hungary should build new quality of bilateral relations – Budanov
headlines.excerpt: Ukraine and Hungary should build a new quality of bilateral relations based on mutual respect, trust and shared security.

headlines.excerpt: Russian forces are attacking Kyiv Oblast with drones for a second day in a row. A woman was injured in the Obukhiv district, the regional military administration reported on Nov. 1.

headlines.excerpt: "A ‘Pantsir-S2’ system and a command and control vehicle belonging to the S-400 ‘Triumph’ system were also struck," Zelensky said, causing an estimated $70 million in damage.

headlines.title: Zelensky: Ukrainian forces liberated more territory in October than Russian invaders seized
headlines.excerpt: In October 2026, Ukraine's Defense Forces inflicted record losses on the Russian army since the start of the full-scale war and liberated 96.2 square kilometers of Ukrainian territory – 10.4 square kilometers more than Russian forces managed to capture during the same period.
